text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's your birthday today, right, Craft? 
Rejoice! I went and made a Magic Tiara 
just for you♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ I've showered it with plentyyy of 
my magic!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
With this, I'll draw out your true power! 
Well? Aren't you thrilled~?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ugh... *sob*...! Thank you so, so much!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Polishing it every day, keeping it safe 
and sound, and when the big moment comes—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I'll display it in a high place and 
worship it!!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yep, yep, that's a great mindset to have♪
